title: Barbie Girl
credit: Barbie Girl (Aqua), melody-line sheet with solfège syllables, arranger unknown
_notation: Per hand, one string per bar. Tokens: pitch (G4, F#4, C5), rest r. Suffix :n = length in eighths (default 1; fractions like 1/2 allowed). Prefix ~ = tied from the previous token of the same pitch (no new attack). Every bar must sum to 8 eighths. Single-staff source: the whole melody is in rh; the left hand is an added accompaniment of half-note triads on Em / D / C / G, two per bar. Repeats written out: printed bars 1-8 are indices 1-8 and 9-16; printed 9-29 are 17-37; printed 30-33 are 38-41 and 42-45; printed 34-40 are 46-52.

sections.name: Verse
sections.hint: "I'm a Barbie girl, in a Barbie world": si-sol-si-MI-DO, then la-fa#-la-RE-si. Left hand: half-note chords Em, D, C, G, one per bar, twice through. Watch the rests that open bars 3, 4 and 7.
sections.coach: Two four-bar phrases over Em, D, C, G. Count the rest at the start of bars 3 and 4.

sections.name: Verse, repeat
sections.hint: The printed repeat of bars 1-8, note for note, chords and all. Bar 13 has the dotted DO (C5) that bar 9 did not.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.hint: "Come on Barbie, let's go party": a half rest, then sol-la-si eighths that tie across every bar line. Each first note of a bar is held over from the bar before, so the attacks are on the off-beats. In bars 21 and 24, sol is held into the bar and the two eighth rests come mid-bar. Left hand: Em for two bars, then C to D in one bar and a bar of D; bar 17 rests its first half with the melody.
sections.coach: Every bar starts tied over: keep the finger down across the bar line. Left hand sits on Em, then C to D.

sections.name: Ah-ah-ah yeah
sections.hint: The high answer: si-DO-RE, then MI-si-RE, MI-DO-RE, RE-MI-RE-RE, all tied across the bar lines, up to the two sixteenths and the held la (A4) in bar 29. Left hand walks Em, G, C, D, D, one chord per bar.
sections.coach: Rest-heavy bars: count the eighth rests aloud, and hold every tied RE. Left hand: Em, G, C, D, D.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.hint: The verse again, identical to bars 1-8: melody and the Em, D, C, G chords.

sections.name: Bridge
sections.hint: "You can brush my hair": sol-sol-mi-re twice, then RE-si-sol-mi-re with eighth rests, then the MI-RE-MI figure on the top space. re is D4, just below the staff. Left hand: Em, G, Em, D, one chord per bar.
sections.coach: Low sol-sol-mi-re: the re is D4 below the staff. Left hand rocks Em to G, then Em to D.

sections.name: Bridge, repeat
sections.hint: The printed repeat of bars 38-41, chords and all.

sections.name: Chorus 2
sections.hint: The chorus again, bars 17-23 note for note, with the same Em, C, D chords under it. The sheet ends here on the tied la (A4), so the last bar is bar 52.
sections.coach: Same tied chorus as before over Em, C and D; finish on the la and let it ring.
